Services

Sharp cuts. Proper shaves.

Every service is finished with the detail work — clean edges, razor finish, styled before you leave the chair. Pick your service and book in under a minute.

  • Skin / Zero Fade

    Seamless skin-tight blends, low, mid or high — crisp lines and a razor finish.

    Book →

  • Haircut & Hot Shave

    The full works: a tailored cut paired with a traditional hot-towel straight-razor shave.

    Book →

  • Hot Towel Shave + Facial Scrub

    Hot towels, rich lather and a close shave, finished with an exfoliating facial scrub.

    Book →

  • Line-Up

    Hairline, beard and edges sharpened up — the quick refresh between full cuts.

    Book →

  • Youth Cuts

    Patient, friendly cuts for young clients — first-timers welcome in the chair.

The Barber

One chair. One craftsman. Zero shortcuts.

At Diamondo, barber El Bachir treats every cut like a signature. Whether you’re after a clean fade, a classic cut, or something bold, you get the same chair, the same hands, and the same attention to detail — every visit.

That consistency is why clients keep coming back: 156 Google reviews averaging 4.95 stars, in a spotless little shop just east of Macleod Trail, south of downtown.

  • ◆He listens first — the cut you asked for is the cut you get
  • ◆Open 7 days, with evening hours that fit real schedules
  • ◆Book online in under a minute — no phone tag
